options: Controls coolant flow to keep the engine at working temperature
questions.explanation: It stays closed while the engine warms up, then opens to send coolant through the radiator.

questions.prompt: Why must you never open the radiator cap on a hot engine?
options: The coolant is under pressure and can spray out scalding hot
The cap is locked when hot
questions.explanation: Hot coolant is kept under pressure. Releasing it suddenly lets it boil and spray.

questions.prompt: What moves the coolant around the engine?
questions.explanation: The water pump's spinning impeller pushes coolant through the engine and radiator.

questions.prompt: The heater blows cold and the temperature gauge stays low. The thermostat is probably…
questions.explanation: Stuck open, it sends coolant to the radiator all the time, so the engine never fully warms up.
